Resolves the innermost remapping for a local def-id from the `generics_def_id_map` stack by iterating in reverse and using `find_map`, `get`, and `copied`, falling back with `unwrap_or` to the original id when no remap exists.

Temporarily switches lowering state to a new HIR owner, runs the supplied lowering closure, packages the produced owner data, and restores the previous context. It calls `local_def_id` to resolve the owner, uses `std::mem::take`/`replace` to swap state, inserts the owner's zero local id with `insert`, invokes the closure `f(self)`, calls `make_owner_info` to build the final owner info, and finally records the owner in `children`.

Executes a closure with an additional generic def-id remapping layer active. It pushes the remap onto `generics_def_id_map`, calls the provided closure `f`, then pops the remap before returning the closure result.

Finalizes the accumulated data for one HIR owner into arena-allocated `OwnerInfo`. It takes the pending attrs, bodies, trait map, and inline-const flag, sorts bodies, builds a `SortedMap` with `from_presorted_elements`, calls `self.tcx.hash_owner_nodes(...)` to compute owner and attribute hashes, calls `index::index_hir` to build node and parenting indices, and allocates the resulting `hir::OwnerInfo` with `self.arena.alloc(...)`.

Maps an AST `NodeId` to a HIR id for the current owner, reusing an existing mapping or allocating a new local id. On a vacant entry it inserts the new local id, advances the counter with `increment_by`, calls `opt_local_def_id` to record nested def ownership in `children`, and transfers any pending trait candidates from `resolver.trait_map.remove(...)` into the local `trait_map`.
Allocates the next fresh `HirId` for the current owner by reading the current counter, incrementing it with `increment_by`, and returning the resulting owner/local-id pair.

Converts a resolver `Res<NodeId>` into a HIR `Res` by calling `apply_id` to rewrite each referenced node id through the current `node_id_to_local_id` mapping, using `get` and `copied` for lookup. If rewriting fails for an enclosing-owner local, it returns `Res::Err` via `unwrap_or`.
Obtains the full resolver result for a node id by calling `self.resolver.get_partial_res(id)` and converting it with `map_or(..., |pr| pr.expect_full_res())`, defaulting to `Res::Err` if missing.

Lowers all present import resolutions for a node into HIR results. It calls `self.resolver.get_import_res(id).present_items()`, lowers each entry by calling `lower_res`, and if nothing is resolved it calls `dcx()` and then `span_delayed_bug` before returning `Res::Err`.
Builds a resolved HIR qpath for a lang item. This method explicitly calls `make_lang_item_path` and wraps the result in `hir::QPath::Resolved`.

Constructs and arena-allocates a single-segment HIR path for a lang item by resolving its `DefId`, computing its `Res`, and creating a fresh segment `HirId`. It calls `require_lang_item`, `def_kind`, and `next_id`.
Marks a span as desugared with the given reason and optional unstable allowances using the stable hashing context and current edition. It calls `with_stable_hashing_context` and `mark_with_reason`.
Adjusts a span for HIR lowering, attaching the current owner as the parent only when incremental compilation is enabled; otherwise returns the span unchanged.
Rebuilds an identifier with its span lowered for HIR. This method explicitly calls `lower_span`.

Converts a resolved lifetime into a HIR lifetime generic parameter, creating a new lifetime definition for fresh elided lifetimes and skipping `static`/error cases. It calls `create_def`, `lower_node_id`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers explicit binder generic parameters, appends resolver-provided extra lifetime parameters, and arena-allocates the combined HIR parameter list. It calls `lower_generic_params_mut`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, and `lifetime_res_to_generic_param`.
Temporarily overrides the `is_in_dyn_type` flag while executing a closure, then restores the previous state.
Executes a closure in a fresh lowering scope by temporarily replacing current item, loop-condition, catch, and loop scope state, then restoring all previous values afterward.
Lowers and stores attributes for a HIR node, returning `None` for an empty attribute list. This method explicitly calls `lower_attr` for each attribute.
Lowers a single AST attribute by preserving its path/data structure, stripping tokens, lowering its arguments, and lowering its span. It calls `lower_attr_args` and `lower_span`.
Aliases already-lowered attributes from one HIR local id to another within the same owner when the target has stored attributes.

Lowers attribute arguments, recursively lowering delimited arguments and converting inert key-value literal expressions into HIR literal form, synthesizing an error literal when parsing fails. It calls `lower_delim_args` and `dcx`.
Lowers delimited attribute arguments by preserving delimiter/span data and flattening the token stream.

Lowers an associated type constraint, including its generic arguments, equality/const/type terms, and bound forms, while diagnosing invalid parenthesized or return-type-notation syntax. This method explicitly calls `lower_angle_bracketed_parameter_data`, `emit_bad_parenthesized_trait_in_assoc_ty`, `dcx`, `lower_ty`, `lower_anon_const`, `lower_param_bounds`, `lower_node_id`, and `lower_ident`.
Emits a diagnostic for illegal parenthesized associated type syntax, computing a targeted suggestion for either removing empty parentheses or replacing them with angle brackets. It calls `dcx`.

Lowers a generic argument as a lifetime, type, inferred arg, or const arg, including the path-type-to-const disambiguation path used for trivial const arguments. It calls `lower_lifetime`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_span`, `get_partial_res`, `next_node_id`, `create_def`, `with_new_scopes`, `lower_const_body`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_anon_const`.
Lowers an AST type and arena-allocates the resulting HIR type node. This method explicitly calls `lower_ty_direct`.

Lowers a path type, opportunistically converting a bare resolved trait path into a trait object when needed for fresh anonymous lifetimes; otherwise lowers it as a normal qpath type. It calls `get_partial_res`, `with_dyn_type_scope`, `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `elided_dyn_bound`, `lower_span`, `next_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_qpath`, and `ty_path`.
Constructs a HIR type node with a fresh `HirId` and lowered span. It calls `next_id` and `lower_span`.
Constructs a tuple HIR type from pre-lowered element types. This method explicitly calls `ty`.

Performs the main AST-to-HIR lowering for type syntax, handling anonymous ADTs, pointers/references, functions, tuples, paths, and other type forms while creating nested owners when required. This method explicitly calls `local_def_id`, `with_hir_id_owner`, `lower_field_def`, `lower_span`, `lower_ty`, `lower_mt`, `get_lifetime_res`, `next_node_id`, `lower_lifetime`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_safety`, `lower_extern`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_fn_params_to_names`.

Lowers an `impl Trait` opaque type by marking its desugared span, determining which lifetimes must be captured or duplicated based on origin and precise captures, and delegating final opaque construction. It calls `mark_span_with_reason`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, `lower_opaque_inner`, and `lower_param_bounds`.

Builds the internal HIR representation for an opaque type: creates the opaque definition, synthesizes duplicated lifetime parameters and mappings, lowers bounds under the remapping, lowers precise captures when present, and emits the owning `OpaqueTy` item plus returned `OpaqueDef` type. It calls `create_def`, `get_lifetime_res`, `dcx`, `next_node_id`, `lower_span`, `lower_ident`, `new_named_lifetime_with_res`, `local_def_id`, `with_hir_id_owner`, `with_remapping`, `lower_item_bounds`, `lower_precise_capturing_args`, and `lower_node_id`.

Extracts lowered parameter names from a function declaration, using the lowered identifier for simple identifier patterns and an empty placeholder ident otherwise. It calls `lower_ident` and `lower_span`.

Lowers a function signature by dropping the AST varargs sentinel, lowering each input type under the appropriate `impl Trait` policy, and lowering the return type either normally or through coroutine-specific opaque-return handling. It calls `lower_ty_direct`, `local_def_id`, `lower_coroutine_fn_ret_ty`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers the return type of async/generator-style functions by creating the desugared opaque return type, collecting captured lifetimes, lowering the coroutine output bound, and returning it as a HIR function return type. It calls `lower_span`, `mark_span_with_reason`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, `lower_opaque_inner`, `lower_coroutine_fn_output_type_to_bound`, `ty`, and `alloc`.

Builds the trait bound placed on a coroutine’s synthesized opaque return type by lowering the explicit/default output type and binding it to the appropriate lang-item associated type (`Future::Output`, `Iterator::Item`, or `AsyncIterator::Item`). It calls `lower_ty`, `ty_tup`, `assoc_ty_binding`, `make_lang_item_path`, and `next_id`.

Lowers a single generic bound into HIR, converting trait bounds and outlives bounds through the appropriate lowerers. It calls `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `lower_trait_bound_modifiers`, and `lower_lifetime`.
Lowers an AST lifetime by first calling `lower_ident` on the lifetime name, then calling `new_named_lifetime` with the original node id to build the HIR lifetime.

Constructs and arena-allocates a HIR lifetime from an explicit `LifetimeRes`, remapping parameter def-ids when needed via `get_remapped_def_id` or `local_def_id`, and filling the HIR node with `lower_node_id` and `lower_ident`.
Resolves a lifetime through `get_lifetime_res`, defaulting to `LifetimeRes::Error` on failure, then calls `new_named_lifetime_with_res` to produce the lowered HIR lifetime.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic parameter by mapping the input slice and calling `lower_generic_param` for every element.
Lowers a slice of generic parameters into arena-allocated HIR output by calling `lower_generic_params_mut` and collecting the iterator with `alloc_from_iter`.

Lowers one generic parameter by calling `lower_generic_param_kind` to compute its HIR name and kind, then assigns ids/spans/attributes using `lower_node_id`, `lower_attrs`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers the kind-specific portion of a generic parameter. For lifetime params it queries `get_lifetime_res` and may call `lower_ident`; for type params it may emit diagnostics through `dcx` and lowers defaults with `lower_ty`; for const params it lowers the type with `lower_ty` and lowers any default const expression with `lower_anon_const`.
Lowers an AST trait reference by calling `lower_qpath`, requiring the result to be a resolved trait path, and then creating the HIR trait ref with `lower_node_id` for the reference id.
Lowers a poly trait reference by calling `lower_lifetime_binder` for bound generic params, `lower_trait_ref` for the trait itself, and `lower_span` for the resulting HIR span.
Lowers a mutable type by calling `lower_ty` on the inner type and preserving the mutability flag.
Lowers a slice of generic bounds into arena-allocated HIR bounds by calling `lower_param_bounds_mut` and collecting with `alloc_from_iter`.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic bound by mapping the slice and calling `lower_param_bound` on each element.

Synthesizes a universal type parameter, its optional where-predicate, and the corresponding type path. It uses `local_def_id`, `lower_span`, `lower_node_id`, and `lower_ident` to build the parameter, calls `lower_generic_bound_predicate` to lower the bounds, and uses `next_id` plus arena allocation to construct the `TyKind::Path`.
Lowers an AST block expression by calling `lower_block` and then wrapping the result with `expr_block`.

Lowers an array length const expression. For `_`, it may create an inferred length using `lower_node_id` and `lower_span` when the feature is enabled; otherwise it reports instability and falls back to calling `lower_anon_const`. All non-underscore lengths are lowered by calling `lower_anon_const`.

Lowers an anonymous const inside fresh scopes by calling `with_new_scopes`; within that closure it uses `local_def_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_const_body`, and `lower_span`, then arena-allocates the resulting HIR anon const.
Maps the AST `UnsafeSource` enum directly to the corresponding HIR `UnsafeSource` variant without calling other methods from the list.

Converts AST trait-bound constness/polarity modifiers into the corresponding HIR trait-bound modifier, consulting the `negative_bounds` feature gate for negative bounds and otherwise performing a direct variant mapping.
Builds a HIR statement by assigning a fresh id with `next_id` and lowering the statement span with `lower_span`.
Builds an expression statement by arena-allocating the expression and then calling `stmt` with `hir::StmtKind::Expr`.

Builds a `let` statement from a pre-lowered pattern and optional initializer. It assigns a fresh id with `next_id`, lowers the span with `lower_span`, stores statement attributes when present, and finally calls `stmt` after arena-allocating the `hir::LetStmt`.
Wraps a lowered expression in a block by calling `block_all` with no statements and the expression as the tail expression.
Constructs and arena-allocates a HIR block from statements and an optional tail expression, assigning a fresh block id with `next_id` and lowering the span with `lower_span`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Continue` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowContinue`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Break` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowBreak`.
Builds an `Option::Some` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the contained pattern and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionSome`.
Builds an `Option::None` pattern by directly calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionNone` and no fields.
Creates a single tuple-struct-style pattern field for index 0, assigning a fresh field id with `next_id` and lowering the field spans with `lower_span`.
Builds a struct pattern referring to a lang item variant by lowering the span with `lower_span` to form a `QPath::LangItem`, then calling `pat` with `hir::PatKind::Struct`.
Builds an identifier pattern with the default binding mode by calling `pat_ident_binding_mode` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE`.

Convenience wrapper that creates a mutable identifier pattern using no explicit binding mode. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE` and returns the resulting pattern and `HirId`.

Builds an identifier pattern with an explicit binding mode, then allocates it in the HIR arena. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` to construct the `hir::Pat` and `self.arena.alloc` to return a shared HIR reference together with its `HirId`.

Constructs an owned `hir::Pat` for an identifier binding with the given binding mode. It calls `next_id` to assign a fresh `HirId`, `lower_ident` to lower the identifier, and `lower_span` to lower the source span.

Allocates a general HIR pattern with default binding modes enabled. It calls `next_id` to create the pattern’s `HirId`, `lower_span` to lower the span, and `self.arena.alloc` to store the pattern in the arena.
Constructs an owned HIR pattern like `pat`, but with `default_binding_modes` disabled. It calls `next_id` for a fresh `HirId` and `lower_span` for the lowered span.

Builds a `hir::Ty` from a qualified path, rewriting resolved trait or trait-alias paths into `hir::TyKind::TraitObject`. In that trait-object case it calls `lower_span` to build the `PolyTraitRef`, `next_id` to give the outer `Ty` a new id, and `elided_dyn_bound` to supply the implicit `dyn` lifetime bound; it also calls `lower_span` again for the final type span.

Creates and arena-allocates an implicit object lifetime bound used for elided `dyn` lifetimes. It calls `next_id` to assign a `HirId`, `lower_span` to lower the span used in the lifetime identifier, and `self.arena.alloc` to return the allocated lifetime.

If the `effects` feature is enabled, lowers a bound constness marker into a synthetic const generic argument and appends it to the argument list. For `Always` and `Maybe` it calls `lcx.lower_span` to lower spans; in the `Maybe` case it may call `lcx.dcx().span_delayed_bug` when `host_param_id` is missing, otherwise it calls `lcx.next_id` to build the host path. After selecting the expression body, it calls `lcx.lower_body` and inside that closure `lcx.expr` to lower the const expression, then calls `lcx.next_node_id`, `lcx.next_id`, and `lcx.create_def` to create the anonymous const, and finally pushes the resulting const argument into `self.args`.
Checks whether the generic-argument builder contains no args, no bindings, and no parenthesized form. It does not call any other methods from the provided list.

Finalizes the builder into an arena-allocated `hir::GenericArgs`. It calls `this.arena.alloc_from_iter` to allocate the argument list, `this.lower_span` to lower the stored span, and `this.arena.alloc` to allocate the completed `hir::GenericArgs`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/lifetime: Constructs a fresh `LifetimeCollectVisitor` with the provided resolver, an empty binder stack, and an empty lifetime collection.

Classifies a lifetime by querying `get_lifetime_res`, then records it only if it is free with respect to `current_binders` or is a special always-collectable case like `'static`/error. It uses `contains` to avoid locally bound or duplicate entries and `push` to store newly collected lifetimes; unexpected resolutions trigger a compiler bug.
Expands an elided-lifetime anchor resolved from `get_lifetime_res` into synthesized underscore `Lifetime` values and calls `record_lifetime_use` for each generated lifetime.
Handles an explicit lifetime node by calling `record_lifetime_use` to classify and collect it if appropriate.
Visits a path segment by first calling `record_elided_anchor` to collect any elided lifetimes attached to the segment, then delegating to `walk_path_segment` to recurse into the segment contents.

Visits a higher-ranked trait reference by pushing its binder onto the current binder stack, calling `walk_poly_trait_ref` to traverse nested nodes under that binding scope, and then popping the binder.

Visits a type while managing binding scopes and elided references: for bare function types it pushes a binder, calls `walk_ty`, then pops it; for `TyKind::Ref(None, _)` it calls `record_elided_anchor` before `walk_ty`; otherwise it just calls `walk_ty`.

Collects free lifetimes appearing in a `GenericBounds` list by creating a visitor with `LifetimeCollectVisitor::new`, calling `visit_param_bound` for each bound, and returning the visitor’s collected lifetimes.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/expr.rs:: Lowers a slice of AST expressions into an arena-allocated HIR slice by iterating over the input and calling `lower_expr_mut` for each element.
Public helper that lowers one AST expression and arena-allocates the result; it calls `lower_expr_mut` to perform the actual lowering.

Main expression-lowering dispatcher that matches on `ExprKind` and builds the corresponding HIR node, including desugarings and diagnostics for special forms. In the shown portion it explicitly calls `lower_expr`, `lower_exprs`, `lower_anon_const`, `lower_array_length`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_span`, `lower_legacy_const_generics`, `lower_path_segment`, `lower_binop`, `lower_unop`, and `lower_ty`.
Converts an AST unary operator directly into the corresponding HIR unary operator without calling other methods from the list.
Converts an AST binary operator into a HIR `BinOp`, preserving its span by calling `lower_span`.

Rewrites a call using legacy const-generic argument positions into a normal generic call by splitting const and value arguments, attaching synthesized generic args to the path, then calling `lower_expr` for the callee and `lower_exprs` for the remaining runtime arguments.
Lowers an `if` expression by calling `lower_cond` for the condition, `lower_block_expr` for the then-block, and `lower_expr` for the optional else-expression.

Lowers a condition expression while preserving the special temporary-lifetime behavior of `let` chains. It calls the local helper `has_let_expr`, and depending on the form calls `lower_binop`, `lower_cond` recursively, `lower_expr`, `mark_span_with_reason`, and `expr_drop_temps`.
Local recursive helper that checks whether an expression tree contains any `let` expression by recursively inspecting binary subexpressions and calling itself on both operands.

Desugars a `while` loop into an HIR `loop` containing an `if` whose else branch breaks. It calls `lower_cond` inside `with_loop_condition_scope`, `lower_block_expr`, `expr_break`, `stmt_expr`, `block_all`, `expr_block`, `expr`, `block_expr`, `lower_span`, and `lower_label`.

Desugars a `try { ... }` block by lowering the block body under a catch scope, wrapping the tail expression with the `Try::from_output` constructor, and returning it as a block expression. It calls `with_catch_scope`, `lower_block_noalloc`, `mark_span_with_reason`, `expr_unit`, and `wrap_in_try_constructor`.
Builds a call to a lang-item constructor around an already-lowered expression; it calls `expr_lang_item_path` to create the callee and `expr_call` to invoke it.

Lowers a match arm, including its pattern, optional guard, attributes, body, and span. It calls `lower_pat`, `lower_span`, `next_id`, `lower_expr`, and `lower_attrs`, and for `if let` guards it calls `lower_pat` and `lower_expr` again to build the lowered `hir::Let`.

Builds the HIR expression kind for a desugared coroutine/async construct by setting up the coroutine kind, synthesized resume/task-context parameters for async forms, the return type, and the lowered closure/coroutine body. It explicitly calls `local_def_id`, `mark_span_with_reason`, `lower_span`, `make_lang_item_qpath`, `next_id`, `pat_ident_binding_mode`, `with_def_id_parent`, and `lower_body`.

Checks whether `async_fn_track_caller` is enabled and the outer HIR node has a `#[track_caller]` attribute; if so, it marks the span as an async desugaring span and forwards a synthesized `#[track_caller]` attribute onto the inner HIR node. Calls `mark_span_with_reason` to adjust the span and `lower_attrs` to attach the generated attribute.

Desugars `.await` into the polling loop over a future, including context access, pinning, poll matching, yielding pending, and breaking with the ready value; it also emits an error outside async contexts. In the shown body it calls `mark_span_with_reason`, `lower_expr_mut`, `pat_ident_binding_mode`, `expr_ident`, `expr_mut_addr_of`, `expr_ident_mut`, `expr_err`, `expr_call_lang_item_fn_mut`, `expr_call_lang_item_fn`, `expr_unsafe`, `next_node_id`, `lower_node_id`, `pat_ident`, `single_pat_field`, `pat_lang_item_variant`, `with_loop_scope`, `lower_loop_destination`, `expr`, `arm`, `expr_block_empty`, `expr_match`, `stmt_expr`, `expr_unit`, `lower_span`, `stmt`, and `block_all`.

Desugars an `.await` expression into the corresponding HIR control-flow structure, including validation that await appears in an async context, creation of temporary bindings, polling/yielding logic, and an error block fallback when used outside async code. It explicitly calls `next_id`, `dcx`, `block_all`, `mark_span_with_reason`, `pat_ident_binding_mode`, `expr_ident`, `expr_mut_addr_of`, `expr_ident_mut`, `expr_call_lang_item_fn_mut`, `expr_call_lang_item_fn`, `expr_unsafe`, `next_node_id`, `lower_node_id`, `pat_ident`, `single_pat_field`, `pat_lang_item_variant`, `with_loop_scope`, `lower_loop_destination`, `arm`, `expr_block_empty`, `expr_match`, `stmt_expr`, `expr_lang_item_path`, `expr_unit`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers a closure expression by lowering its binder, body, generator metadata, generic params, and function declaration, then assembling a HIR closure node. It calls `lower_closure_binder`, `with_new_scopes`, `lower_fn_body`, `lower_expr_mut`, `generator_movability_for_fn`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_span`.

Determines the resulting `hir::ClosureKind` for a function-like expression from its coroutine kind and movability, emitting diagnostics for invalid coroutine parameter counts or `static` non-coroutine closures. It explicitly calls `dcx` to emit those errors.
Lowers a closure binder into its HIR form and returns the associated generic parameters slice, calling `lower_span` when a `for<...>` binder is present.

Lowers an async coroutine closure expression by creating the closure def-id/binder, lowering an inner moved-argument coroutine body within fresh scopes, forwarding `track_caller`, lowering generic lifetime binders and the function declaration, and finally constructing the HIR closure node as a coroutine closure. It explicitly calls `local_def_id`, `lower_closure_binder`, `with_new_scopes`, `with_def_id_parent`, `lower_body`, `lower_coroutine_body_with_moved_arguments`, `lower_expr_mut`, `maybe_forward_track_caller`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers assignment expressions, using plain HIR assignment for ordinary lvalues and desugaring destructuring assignment into a temporary `let` plus per-place assignments otherwise. It calls the local helper `is_ordinary`, and for destructuring paths calls `lower_expr`, `lower_span`, `destructure_assign`, `stmt_let_pat`, and `block_all`.

Local recursive helper that decides whether an assignment lhs is a normal assignable place or needs destructuring desugaring; it calls `extract_tuple_struct_path` for call expressions and calls itself recursively through parenthesized expressions.
Checks whether an expression is a path usable as a tuple-struct or tuple-variant pattern and returns its `qself`/path pair if so; it does not call other methods from the list.
Checks whether an expression is a path usable as a unit-struct or unit-variant pattern and returns its `qself`/path pair if so; it does not call other methods from the list.
Convenience wrapper that lowers a destructuring-assignment lhs into an arena-allocated HIR pattern by calling `destructure_assign_mut`.

Recursively lowers a destructuring-assignment lhs into a mutable HIR pattern and records side-effecting assignment statements for bound places. In the shown body it calls `pat_without_dbm`, `destructure_sequence`, `extract_tuple_struct_path`, `lower_qpath`, `extract_unit_struct_path`, `destructure_assign`, `next_id`, `lower_ident`, `lower_span`, `pat_ident_mut`, `expr_ident`, `lower_expr`, `expr`, `push`, and `stmt_expr`.

Lowers a sequence-shaped destructuring lhs, collecting element patterns and at most one `..` rest position. It calls `destructure_assign_mut` for non-rest elements and `ban_extra_rest_pat` when multiple rest patterns are found.
Desugars a closed range expression into a call to the `RangeInclusive::new` lang item by calling `lower_expr_mut` on both endpoints, `lower_span`, and `expr` to construct the callee path.

Lowers non-closed range syntax into a struct expression for the appropriate range lang item, selecting the lang item shape, emitting an error for inclusive ranges without an end, and lowering present endpoints. It calls `lower_expr`, `lower_span`, and `expr_field`.
Lowers an optional loop label by lowering its identifier; it calls `lower_ident`.
Lowers a `break`/`continue` destination by resolving either an explicit label or the current loop scope into a HIR target id and lowered label. It calls `lower_node_id` and `lower_label`.

Lowers a break/continue destination, rejecting unlabeled control flow inside a while-condition by producing `UnlabeledCfInWhileCondition`; otherwise it calls `lower_loop_destination` on the optional mapped label.
Temporarily installs a catch scope `NodeId`, runs the provided closure, then restores the previous catch scope.
Temporarily enters a loop scope, clears `is_in_loop_condition` while running the provided closure, then restores the previous loop scope and loop-condition flag.
Temporarily marks lowering as occurring inside a loop condition while running the provided closure, then restores the prior flag.
Lowers an AST struct field initializer into `hir::ExprField` by calling `lower_node_id`, `lower_attrs`, `lower_ident`, `lower_expr`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers a `yield` expression, updating or validating generator state, emitting an error for async generators, and producing `hir::ExprKind::Yield`; it calls `lower_expr` for an explicit yielded value or `expr_unit` when the value is omitted.

Desugars a `for` loop into iterator-driving HIR loop/match structure. It calls `lower_expr_mut`, `lower_pat`, `mark_span_with_reason`, and `lower_span` for the input pieces; uses `with_loop_scope` together with `expr_break_alloc` and `lower_block` to build loop bodies; constructs patterns and arms via `pat_none`, `pat_some`, `pat_ident_binding_mode`, and `arm`; builds iterator/next calls with `expr_ident`, `expr_mut_addr_of`, and `expr_call_lang_item_fn`; forms the match and enclosing block with `expr_match`, `stmt_expr`, `block_all`, and `expr_block`; then lowers the optional label with `lower_label`, assigns ids with `lower_node_id`, and wraps the result with `expr_drop_temps_mut`.

Desugars the `?` operator into a `Try::branch` match over `ControlFlow`, including generated `allow(unreachable_code)` attributes and either continuing with the value or propagating the residual. It calls `mark_span_with_reason`, `lower_expr_mut`, `expr_call_lang_item_fn`, `lower_span`, `pat_ident`, `expr_ident_with_attrs`, `pat_cf_continue`, `arm`, `expr_ident_mut`, `wrap_in_try_constructor`, `lower_node_id`, and `expr` to build the final HIR match/return-or-break structure.

Desugars a `yeet` expression by lowering the payload with `lower_expr` or synthesizing `()` with `expr_unit`, marking desugaring spans with `mark_span_with_reason`, wrapping the value via `wrap_in_try_constructor`, and then producing either a catch-targeted `Break` using `lower_node_id` or a `Ret` if no catch scope is active.
Allocates and returns a `DropTemps` expression by calling `expr_drop_temps_mut` and storing the result in the arena.
Builds a `hir::ExprKind::DropTemps` expression by calling `expr`.
Builds a HIR `match` expression from a scrutinee, arms, and match source by calling `expr`.
Builds an unlabeled `break` expression targeting the current loop by calling `lower_loop_destination` and then `expr`.
Allocates and returns a `break` expression by calling `expr_break` and storing the result in the arena.
Builds a mutable reference expression `&mut e` by calling `expr` with `hir::ExprKind::AddrOf`.
Allocates and returns the unit expression `()` by calling `expr` with an empty tuple and storing it in the arena.
Builds a HIR `usize` integer literal expression by allocating a `hir::Lit` and wrapping it as `hir::ExprKind::Lit`. Calls `expr` to produce the final HIR expression.
Builds a HIR `u32` integer literal expression by allocating a `hir::Lit` and wrapping it as `hir::ExprKind::Lit`. Calls `expr` to produce the final HIR expression.
Builds a HIR character literal expression by allocating a `hir::Lit` with `Char` kind and wrapping it as `hir::ExprKind::Lit`. Calls `expr` to produce the final HIR expression.
Builds a HIR cooked string literal expression by allocating a `hir::Lit` with `Str` kind and wrapping it as `hir::ExprKind::Lit`. Calls `expr` to produce the final HIR expression.
Builds a call expression node from a callee and arguments by calling `expr`.
Allocates and returns a call expression by calling `expr_call_mut` and storing the result in the arena.
Builds a call to a lang-item function by first calling `expr_lang_item_path` to create the callee path, then `expr_call_mut` to form the call expression.
Allocates and returns a lang-item function call by calling `expr_call_lang_item_fn_mut` and storing the result in the arena.
Builds a path expression referring to a lang item by calling `lower_span` for the embedded path span and `expr` for the final HIR node.

Constructs a HIR type-relative path expression of the form `<lang item type>::name` by creating a `LangItem` type path and a fresh path segment, then wrapping them in `hir::ExprKind::Path`. Calls `ty` to build the receiver type, `lower_span` for the lang-item path span, `next_id` to allocate the path segment id, and `expr` to produce the final HIR expression.
Allocates and returns a local identifier expression by calling `expr_ident_mut` and storing the result in the arena.
Builds a local identifier expression without allocation by calling `expr_ident_with_attrs` with empty attributes.
Wraps an expression in a compiler-generated unsafe block by calling `next_id`, `lower_span`, and `expr` after allocating the enclosing `hir::Block`.
Builds and allocates an empty block expression by calling `block_all` to create the block and `expr_block` to wrap it as an expression.
Builds a block expression from an existing HIR block by calling `expr`.

Constructs an immutable reference to an array expression by first building `hir::ExprKind::Array(elements)`, allocating it, and then wrapping it in `hir::ExprKind::AddrOf`. Calls `expr` both to create the inner array expression and to return the final reference expression.

Core constructor for HIR expressions: creates a fresh HIR id with `next_id`, records any attributes with `lower_attrs`, lowers the source span with `lower_span`, and returns the assembled `hir::Expr`.
Constructs a non-shorthand HIR struct field expression, assigning a fresh field id with `next_id` and lowering the field span with `lower_span`.
Constructs a match arm with no guard, assigning a fresh arm id with `next_id` and lowering the arm span from the body expression via `lower_span`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/path.rs:: Lowers an AST path plus optional `QSelf` into an HIR `QPath`, using resolver `PartialRes` to split the resolved base from unresolved projections, handling async trait-bound remapping, and constructing either resolved or type-relative path forms. It calls `lower_ty` to lower the `QSelf` type, `lower_res` to convert the base resolution, `map_trait_to_async_trait` when an `async` bound targets an `Fn*` trait, `lower_path_segment` to lower every path segment with the appropriate generic-argument mode, `mark_span_with_reason` to tag desugared async-bound spans, `lower_span` for final HIR spans, and `next_id` when synthesizing type-relative HIR nodes.

Lowers an import path into `hir::UsePath`, preserving the provided per-namespace `Res` list and lowering each segment in a context where generic arguments are rejected. It calls `lower_path_segment` for each path segment and `lower_span` for the resulting path span.

Lowers one AST `PathSegment` into an HIR path segment by converting its identifier, resolution, and generic arguments, while diagnosing invalid parenthesized generics, return-type notation misuse, and missing angle brackets. It calls `lower_angle_bracketed_parameter_data` for `<...>` arguments, `lower_parenthesized_parameter_data` for `(...)` function-trait style arguments, `maybe_insert_elided_lifetimes_in_path` to synthesize omitted lifetime arguments when required, `lower_node_id`, `lower_ident`, and `lower_res` to finish the HIR segment, and uses resolver-backed `expect_full_res` to fetch the segment resolution.

Inserts synthesized elided lifetime generic arguments at the front of a path segment when the resolver recorded an elision anchor, choosing a diagnostic span based on whether brackets and other arguments are present. It calls `lower_lifetime` for each generated anonymous lifetime before wrapping them as lifetime generic arguments.

Lowers angle-bracketed generic arguments and associated-item constraints into an intermediate `GenericArgsCtor`, while also reporting whether the arguments are effectively elidable in optional-parameter mode. It calls `lower_generic_arg` for each non-constraint generic argument and `lower_assoc_item_constraint` for each associated-item constraint.

Lowers parenthesized function-trait-style generic arguments by turning inputs into a tuple argument and the return type into an `Output` associated type constraint, while enforcing the allowed `impl Trait` contexts and propagating async-bound feature tagging. It calls `lower_ty_direct` to lower input types, `lower_ty` to lower the return type under the correct `ImplTraitContext`, `ty_tup` to build tuple types for inputs or default unit output, `mark_span_with_reason` to tag desugared async-bound output spans, and `assoc_ty_binding` to create the synthetic `Output = ...` constraint.

Builds an HIR associated-type equality constraint like `Output = T` with empty generic arguments and fresh HIR identity data. It calls `next_id` to allocate the constraint HIR id and `lower_span` to lower the source span.

Maps the lang-item `Fn`, `FnMut`, or `FnOnce` trait `DefId` to its corresponding async function-trait lang item, returning `None` for all other traits. It does not call other methods from the listed methods set.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/item.rs:: Selects the preferred parsed type-alias `where` clause location and copies its `has_where_token` flag and span into `generics.where_clause`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Creates and initializes a fresh `LoweringContext` for one HIR owner, runs the supplied lowering closure inside `with_hir_id_owner`, and then publishes collected child-owner info back into `self.owners`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Entry point for lowering a `LocalDefId`: ensures an owner slot exists, skips already-lowered owners, dispatches by `AstOwner` kind, and returns the cached/lowered owner. It explicitly calls `lower_crate`, `lower_item`, `lower_assoc_item`, and `lower_foreign_item` depending on the AST owner kind.

Lowers the crate root as the crate HIR owner by creating a lowering context with `with_lctx`, lowering the top-level module, lowering crate attributes, and allocating a `hir::OwnerNode::Crate`. It explicitly calls `with_lctx` and, inside the closure, `lower_mod`.

Lowers one AST item as its own HIR owner by invoking `with_lctx` and wrapping the lowered result as `hir::OwnerNode::Item`. It explicitly calls `with_lctx` and, inside the closure, `LoweringContext::lower_item`.

Lowers an associated item after first lowering its parent owner so parent HIR context is available, sets `is_in_trait_impl` when the parent is a trait impl, and then lowers the item as either a trait item or impl item. It explicitly calls `lower_node`, `with_lctx`, and then either `lower_trait_item` or `lower_impl_item`.

Lowers a foreign item as its own HIR owner via `with_lctx` and wraps it as `hir::OwnerNode::ForeignItem`. It explicitly calls `with_lctx` and, inside the closure, `LoweringContext::lower_foreign_item`.
Builds a HIR module by lowering module spans and collecting all contained item ids into arena storage. It explicitly calls `lower_item_ref` for each item.

Produces the HIR `ItemId` list referenced by an AST item, starting with the item's own id and expanding `use` items to include desugared imports. It explicitly calls `lower_item_id_use_tree` for `ItemKind::Use`.

Recursively flattens a `use` tree into all generated `hir::ItemId`s, descending into nested imports and adding extra ids for multi-namespace simple imports. It explicitly calls itself recursively via `lower_item_id_use_tree`.
Constructs a full HIR item by lowering spans, owner id, attributes, item kind, and identifier, then allocating the result. It explicitly calls `lower_item_kind`.

Dispatches lowering for each AST `ItemKind` into the corresponding HIR form, including imports, const/statics, functions, modules, foreign modules, global asm, type aliases, enums, and structs. It explicitly calls `lower_use_tree`, `lower_const_item`, `lower_maybe_async_body`, `lower_fn_decl`, `lower_mod`, `lower_foreign_item_ref`, `lower_inline_asm`, `add_ty_alias_where_clause`, `lower_generics`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_variant` in the relevant match arms.
Lowers a const-like item's declared type and body expression, returning the HIR type plus body id. It explicitly calls `lower_const_body`.

Lowers a `use` tree into HIR import form, handling prefix concatenation, `self` imports, multi-namespace desugaring, nested imports, and creation of extra synthetic child owners for split imports. It explicitly calls itself recursively via `lower_use_tree` when lowering nested imports.

Lowers an associated AST item into either a HIR trait item or impl item after deriving the effective constness from the parent trait/impl owner. It inspects the parent with `node` and `expect_item`, and for trait items calls `lower_trait_item`; for impl items it calls `lower_impl_item`.

Constructs a HIR foreign item by lowering its owner id, attributes, identifier, kind, and spans, with special handling for extern functions, statics, and type aliases. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Builds a lightweight `hir::ForeignItemRef` containing the lowered id, identifier, and span for a foreign item reference. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Lowers one enum variant by lowering its id, attributes, field data, optional discriminant, identifier, and span. It explicitly calls `lower_variant_data`.

Lowers struct-, tuple-, or unit-style variant payloads, creating field definitions and aliasing constructor attributes to the parent where needed. It explicitly calls `lower_field_def` for each field.

Lowers a struct or tuple field definition, choosing path-specific or general type lowering, then lowering field id, attributes, spans, and identifier. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers a trait associated item into HIR, handling consts, required/provided methods, and type aliases with merged type-alias `where` clauses, plus final attributes and spans. It explicitly calls `add_ty_alias_where_clause` when lowering associated type aliases.
Builds a lightweight `hir::TraitItemRef` describing a trait associated item’s id, kind, defaultness, identifier, and span. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Builds a HIR error expression for the given span and guaranteed error by calling `expr` with `hir::ExprKind::Err`.

Lowers an impl associated item into HIR, handling consts, methods, and type aliases, including merged type-alias `where` clauses and trait-vs-inherent method context. It explicitly calls `add_ty_alias_where_clause` when lowering associated type aliases.

Builds a lightweight `hir::ImplItemRef` containing the impl item’s id, identifier, span, defaultness, kind, and optional linked trait-item def id. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Converts AST defaultness into HIR defaultness, preserving the lowered `default` span when present and asserting finals always have a value. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Creates a HIR body from parameters and an expression, verifies it belongs to the current owner, stores it in the owner body table, and returns its `BodyId`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Runs a closure to lower a body while temporarily saving and restoring generator/task-context state, then records the resulting HIR body. It explicitly calls `record_body`.
Lowers a function parameter by lowering its id, attributes, pattern, and type/span information into `hir::Param`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Lowers a function body by first lowering all input parameters and then lowering the body expression inside the generic body-lowering wrapper. It explicitly calls `lower_body` and `lower_param`.
Convenience wrapper for lowering a function body stored as an optional block expression. It explicitly calls `lower_fn_body` and `lower_block_expr_opt`.
Lowers an optional block into an expression, or produces an error expression when the block is missing. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers an optional const expression into a HIR body. It calls `lower_body` to create the body, and inside that closure calls `lower_expr_mut` for a present expression or `expr_err` to synthesize an error expression when the const body is missing.

Lowers a function body, using the normal path when the function is not a coroutine and the coroutine desugaring path otherwise. In the non-coroutine case it calls `lower_fn_body_block`; in the coroutine case it calls `lower_body`, whose closure calls `lower_coroutine_body_with_moved_arguments`, `lower_block_expr`, `lower_node_id`, and `maybe_forward_track_caller`.

Desugars coroutine/async function parameters into moved captures plus local `let` bindings, then wraps the lowered body in the coroutine expression structure needed for correct capture and drop order. It calls `lower_param` for each input, uses helpers such as `pat_ident`, `expr_ident`, `stmt_let_pat`, `pat_ident_binding_mode`, `expr_drop_temps`, `block_all`, `expr_block`, and `lower_body`, allocates HIR nodes with `alloc`/`alloc_from_iter`, and finally creates the coroutine with `make_desugared_coroutine_expr` after obtaining the closure HIR id via `lower_node_id`.

Lowers a method signature by translating the header, injecting implicit generics, and lowering the function declaration. It calls `lower_fn_header`, `add_implicit_generics`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_span`.
Lowers an AST `FnHeader` into its HIR form by translating each header flag. It calls `lower_unsafety`, `lower_asyncness`, `lower_constness`, and `lower_extern`.
Resolves a parsed ABI string into a concrete `abi::Abi`. If lookup fails, it calls `error_on_invalid_abi` and falls back to `abi::Abi::Rust`.
Lowers an `Extern` specifier into the effective ABI. For explicit extern declarations, it calls `lower_abi`; otherwise it returns the default Rust or fallback ABI directly.
Emits the diagnostic for an invalid ABI literal, labeling the ABI span and listing valid ABI names. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Converts AST constness into HIR constness by mapping `Const::Yes` to `hir::Constness::Const` and `Const::No` to `hir::Constness::NotConst`. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Converts AST unsafety into HIR unsafety by mapping `Unsafe::Yes` to `hir::Unsafety::Unsafe` and `Unsafe::No` to `hir::Unsafety::Normal`. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Lowers generics fully into `hir::Generics` by first building the intermediate representation and then materializing arena-backed storage. It calls `lower_generics_mut` and `into_generics`.

Builds a HIR where-predicate for a generic parameter’s bounds, skipping empty bounds and reconstructing an appropriate predicate span. It first calls `lower_param_bounds` and `lower_ident`; for type parameters it then calls `local_def_id`, `next_id`, `alloc`, `alloc_from_iter`, and `ty_path`, while for lifetime parameters it calls `lower_ident`, `next_node_id`, and `new_named_lifetime`.

Lowers one AST where-predicate into its HIR variant. Depending on the predicate kind, it calls `lower_generic_params`, `lower_ty`, `lower_param_bound`, and `lower_span` for bound predicates; `lower_span`, `lower_lifetime`, and `lower_param_bounds` for region predicates; and `lower_node_id`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span` for equality predicates.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_resolve/src/late.rs::impl: Returns a fixed human-readable description string for each `PatternSource` variant; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Converts a `PatternSource` into a borrowed string diagnostic argument by calling `PatternSource::descr` and wrapping the result in `DiagnosticArgValue::Str`.
Forces the state to `Yes` when the boolean flag is true, otherwise preserves the existing `ConstantHasGenerics` value; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Returns the textual keyword for the constant item kind, mapping `Const` to `"const"` and `Static` to `"static"`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Classifies whether a `RibKind` represents a scope that contains generic parameters, returning `true` for assoc/item-style barriers and `false` for normal/function/module/const-param-like ribs; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Determines whether a rib kind blocks label lookup across that scope, treating most item/function-like ribs as barriers and `Normal`/`MacroDefinition` as non-barriers; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Constructs a new `Rib` with default-initialized bindings and the provided `RibKind`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Returns a short descriptive string for each `LifetimeBinderKind`, such as `type`, `bound`, `item`, `impl block`, `function`, or `closure`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Constructs a new `LifetimeRib` with default bindings and the supplied `LifetimeRibKind`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Maps each `PathSource` to the namespace late resolution should search, using the type namespace for type/trait/struct contexts, the value namespace for expression/pattern/tuple-struct/delegation contexts, and preserving the namespace stored in `TraitItem`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Indicates whether unresolved handling for this path source should be deferred to type checking, returning `true` for most type/value path contexts and `false` for trait, trait-item, and delegation contexts; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Produces the user-facing description of what kind of entity a path is expected to resolve to, with extra inspection for call expressions to distinguish values, functions, tuple structs/variants, and external crates; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Checks whether the path source is specifically an expression used as a call target; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Validates whether a resolved `Res` is acceptable for the given path context by matching allowed definition kinds per source. It explicitly calls `Res::expected_in_unit_struct_pat` and `Res::expected_in_tuple_struct_pat` for pattern-related cases.

Selects the appropriate resolution error code for this path context, distinguishing between missing names and names that resolved to an unexpected kind; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Evaluates whether a documented target should be treated as exported by deriving a local `DefId` or visibility-based answer from the `MaybeExported` variant, then consulting effective visibilities when needed; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Intentionally skips resolving attribute contents because attribute expressions do not correspond to executable code; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Enters item resolution by updating diagnostic state, forcing item-level error reporting, and resolving the item inside an item lifetime rib. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_item`.
Delegates match-arm handling directly to the arm resolver. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_arm`.
Resolves a block while saving and restoring the enclosing `macro_rules` scope to prevent leakage across block traversal. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_block`.
Rejects generic visitor traversal of anonymous constants and forces callers to use the dedicated anon-const resolution path instead; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Delegates expression traversal to the late expression resolver with no special parent expression context. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_expr`.
Temporarily records the current pattern for diagnostics, then performs normal pattern walking; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Captures span metadata for a non-wild local binding to improve diagnostics, then resolves the local and restores the previous let-binding context. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_local`.

Resolves type syntax with specialized handling for elided reference lifetimes, type paths, implicit `Self`, impl traits, trait objects, bare function types, arrays, const arguments, and `typeof`. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_elided_lifetime`, `LateResolutionVisitor::smart_resolve_path`, `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_path`, `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`, `LateResolutionVisitor::record_lifetime_params_for_impl_trait`, `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_generic_params`, `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_fn_signature`, and `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_anon_const`.

Resolves a higher-ranked trait reference inside a generic-parameter and lifetime binder scope, visiting bound generics before resolving and traversing the trait reference itself. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_generic_params`, `LateResolutionVisitor::smart_resolve_path`, and `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_trait_ref`.

Resolves doc links for a foreign item, then dispatches foreign type aliases and functions through generic-parameter ribs, statics through a static rib, and rejects unexpanded foreign macros. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_doc_links`.

Resolves function and closure signatures, generics, ribs, labels, parameters, return types, bodies, and coroutine/impl-trait lifetime bookkeeping, with special early handling for foreign or body-less functions. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_fn_header`, `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_generics`, `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_fn_signature`, `LateResolutionVisitor::record_lifetime_params_for_impl_trait`, `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_closure_binder`, `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_params`, `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_block`, and `LateResolutionVisitor::visit_expr`.
Delegates lifetime uses directly to the lifetime resolver. It explicitly calls `LateResolutionVisitor::resolve_lifetime`.
Resolves a generics block by visiting its generic parameters and then each where-clause predicate. It explicitly calls `visit_generic_params` and `visit_where_predicate`.
Resolves a closure binder; it does nothing for `NotPresent` and, for `for<...>` binders, visits the binder's generic parameters. It explicitly calls `visit_generic_params`.

Resolves a generic argument while marking that generic arguments are being processed. For type arguments, it may reinterpret a trivial path type as a const argument by probing lexical resolution with `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`, then resolving it inside `resolve_anon_const_manual` via `smart_resolve_path` and `visit_path`; otherwise it visits the type with `visit_ty`. For lifetime arguments it calls `visit_lifetime`, and for const arguments it calls `resolve_anon_const`.

Resolves an associated-item constraint by visiting its identifier, optional generic arguments, and constraint body. It explicitly calls `visit_ident`, wraps generic arguments in `with_lifetime_rib` before calling `visit_generic_args`, uses `visit_ty` or `resolve_anon_const` for equality terms, and calls `record_lifetime_params_for_impl_trait` for bound constraints.

Resolves generic arguments attached to a path segment. For angle-bracketed arguments it delegates to `visit::walk_generic_args`; for parenthesized arguments it inspects lifetime ribs and either introduces an anonymous-lifetime rib with `with_lifetime_rib` and resolves the function-like signature via `resolve_fn_signature`, or falls back to `visit::walk_generic_args`.

Resolves a where-clause predicate while tracking it in diagnostic metadata and forbidding anonymous lifetimes by default. For bound predicates it enters `with_lifetime_rib`, then `with_generic_param_rib`, and explicitly calls `visit_generic_params`, `visit_ty`, and `visit_param_bound`; otherwise it falls back to `visit::walk_where_predicate`.

Resolves names inside an inline assembly block by walking each operand. It explicitly calls `visit_expr` for input/output expressions, `resolve_anon_const` for const operands, `visit_inline_asm_sym` for symbol operands, and `visit_block` for label operands.

Resolves an inline-asm symbol path inside dedicated value, type, and label ribs so surrounding bindings are blocked like anon-const resolution. It explicitly nests `with_rib` and `with_label_rib`, then calls `smart_resolve_path` and `visit::walk_inline_asm_sym`.
Resolves documentation links attached to an enum variant and then walks the variant body. It explicitly calls `resolve_doc_links` and `visit::walk_variant`.
Resolves an enum variant discriminant as an anonymous const in enum-discriminant context. It explicitly calls `resolve_anon_const`.
Resolves documentation links attached to a field definition and then walks the field. It explicitly calls `resolve_doc_links` and `visit::walk_field_def`.

Constructs a late-resolution visitor rooted at the crate graph root, initializing parent scope, namespace ribs, label and lifetime stacks, and diagnostic state. It explicitly calls `ParentScope::module`, `Rib::new`, and `Default::default`.
Attempts lexical-scope resolution of an identifier in a namespace without finalization or ignored bindings. It explicitly calls `Resolver::resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`.
Resolves an identifier in the current lexical scope with configurable finalization and optional binding suppression. It explicitly calls `Resolver::resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`.
Resolves a path against the current parent scope and rib stacks, optionally in a specific namespace and finalize mode. It explicitly calls `Resolver::resolve_path_with_ribs`.
Runs a closure inside a temporary namespace rib, pushing a new rib before execution and popping it afterward. It explicitly calls `Rib::new` around the provided `work` closure.

Executes work in the module scope for a node when that node defines a module, temporarily switching `parent_scope.module` and pushing module ribs for both value and type namespaces. It explicitly calls `get_module`, `replace`, `with_rib`, and then the supplied closure `f`.

Resolves generic parameter declarations while enforcing forward-reference bans for later type/const parameters and optionally `Self` in ADT defaults. Inside `with_lifetime_rib`, it explicitly calls `visit_param_bound` for bounds, `visit_ty` for type defaults, and `resolve_anon_const` for const defaults, while pushing and removing temporary ban ribs as parameters become available.
Runs a closure inside a temporary lifetime rib, saving and restoring lifetime-elision candidates around the work. It explicitly calls `LifetimeRib::new` around the provided `work` closure.

Resolves a named or anonymous lifetime use by handling `'static`, delegating `_` to `resolve_anonymous_lifetime`, and otherwise searching lifetime ribs from innermost to outermost. On success it explicitly calls `record_lifetime_res`; on special error cases it emits diagnostics such as forbidden non-static or undeclared lifetime errors.

Resolves an underscore or elided lifetime according to the active lifetime ribs. It may create a fresh lifetime with `create_fresh_lifetime` and record it with `record_lifetime_res`, emit lints or errors for forbidden anonymous lifetimes, accumulate elision failures, or report missing lifetime specifiers via `report_missing_lifetime_specifiers`.

Creates a synthetic underscore lifetime for an elided lifetime position, records an anchor range for it, and resolves it as an anonymous lifetime. It explicitly calls `record_lifetime_res` and `resolve_anonymous_lifetime`.
Allocates a fresh synthetic lifetime parameter for an anonymous lifetime, records it, and stores it for later HIR lowering. It explicitly calls `record_lifetime_param`.

Resolves omitted lifetime arguments in path segments that refer to lifetime-parameterized types or traits. It explicitly calls `record_lifetime_res` to create anchor and inferred entries; depending on context it may call `create_fresh_lifetime`, emit diagnostics, buffer lints, or call `report_missing_lifetime_specifiers` when explicit lifetimes are required.

Records the resolved meaning of a lifetime node, panicking if the node was already resolved, and tracks elision candidates for named, fresh, or static lifetimes. It updates the resolution map directly and does not call other listed methods.
Records the resolved meaning of a lifetime parameter node, panicking on duplicate resolution. It updates the resolution map directly and does not call other listed methods.

Resolves the lifetimes of a function signature by first resolving parameter patterns and types, then resolving the return type under the appropriate elision rib, and finally reporting elision failures if needed. It explicitly calls `resolve_fn_params`, wraps return-type traversal in `with_lifetime_rib`, and may call `report_missing_lifetime_specifiers`.

Resolves function parameter patterns and types while computing the lifetime elision candidate for the signature. For each parameter it explicitly calls `with_lifetime_rib` to resolve patterns via `resolve_pattern`, then calls `visit_ty` to collect lifetime candidates, and finally uses `find_lifetime_for_self` when `self`-based elision may apply.

Searches a type for references of the form `&'a Self` (including implicit/desugared self forms) to identify elision candidates tied to `self`. It builds a local visitor whose `visit_ty` logic uses `is_self_ty`, then walks the type to collect matching lifetime resolutions.

Checks whether a type denotes `Self`, either as implicit self, an explicit self type parameter/alias, or the current impl self type. It reads the path resolution via `full_res` and performs no calls to other listed methods.

Visits a type while detecting `&Self` references and recording the resolved lifetime used by that reference; when the referenced inner type is `Self`, it uses `is_self_ty` and stores the lifetime resolution, then calls `visit::walk_ty` to continue traversing nested type structure.
Overrides expression visiting as a no-op so this visitor only inspects types and does not recurse into expressions.

Resolves a loop/block label by searching label ribs from innermost to outermost, adjusting macro-generated labels when crossing `MacroDefinition` ribs, and returning either the matching label or an error. It explicitly calls `is_label_valid_from_rib` to reject labels hidden behind barriers and `suggestion_for_label_in_rib` to collect typo suggestions.
Checks whether a resolved label is reachable from the current scope by scanning intervening label ribs for barriers. It explicitly calls `is_label_barrier` on each rib kind.

Resolves an enum/struct/union item by installing the current self item, generic-parameter scopes, and a `Self` type alias for the ADT, then traversing the item body. It explicitly calls `with_current_self_item`, `with_generic_param_rib`, `with_self_rib`, and `visit::walk_item`.

Checks `use` trees for imports that incorrectly refer to local variables or type parameters, emitting future-proofing diagnostics for such lexical-scope captures. For each relevant namespace it explicitly calls `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`, may call `resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope` to probe through an item binding, and recursively calls `future_proof_import` on nested imports.

Dispatches late resolution for each item kind, setting up the appropriate ribs, doc-link handling, and specialized resolution flow. It explicitly calls `resolve_doc_links` for most items, `with_generic_param_rib` plus `visit::walk_item` for type aliases and functions, `resolve_adt` for enums/structs/unions, `resolve_implementation` for impls, `with_self_rib`, `visit_generics`, and `resolve_trait_items` for traits, `with_scope` for trait aliases, `with_static_rib`, `with_lifetime_rib`, `visit_ty`, and `resolve_const_body` for statics/consts, and `future_proof_import` for nested-use imports.

Creates temporary type, value, and lifetime ribs for generic parameters, records their bindings, checks for duplicate names and lifetime shadowing, runs a nested resolution action, then tears the ribs down and reports lifetime uses. It explicitly calls `Rib::new`, `signal_lifetime_shadowing`, `record_lifetime_param`, `report_error`, `record_partial_res`, and `maybe_report_lifetime_uses`.
Pushes a new label rib for the duration of a closure and then pops it afterward. It explicitly calls `Rib::new` before executing the nested action.
Creates item-style ribs in both value and type namespaces for resolving a static item body. It explicitly calls `with_rib` twice, nesting the `TypeNS` rib inside the `ValueNS` rib.

Establishes the restricted scope used while resolving const contexts, including value/type ribs, label restrictions, and optional lifetime restrictions for anon consts. It explicitly calls `with_rib` for `ValueNS` and `TypeNS`, uses `force_yes_if` to relax generic usage for repeat expressions, calls `with_label_rib` for label scoping, and conditionally calls `with_lifetime_rib` when generics are forbidden.
Temporarily records the current `Self` type in diagnostic metadata while running a nested action, restoring the previous value afterward.
Temporarily records the current self item id in diagnostic metadata while running a nested action, then restores the previous value.

Resolves all associated items of a trait, setting current-trait metadata and installing per-item generic/lifetime scopes as needed. It explicitly calls `resolve_doc_links` for each item; for most associated items it uses `with_generic_param_rib` and `visit::walk_assoc_item`, while associated consts additionally call `visit_generics`, `visit_ty`, and `resolve_const_body`, delegations call `resolve_delegation`, and associated types may call `with_lifetime_rib` before walking.

Temporarily resolves and installs the trait reference for an impl, making both the trait module and resolved trait `DefId` available to nested resolution. It explicitly calls `smart_resolve_path_fragment` to resolve the trait path, `expect_full_res` and `opt_def_id` to extract the result, `expect_module` to store the trait module, and then invokes the nested closure.
Pushes a temporary rib in the given namespace containing a `Self` binding, runs a nested action, and then removes the rib. It explicitly calls `Rib::new` to create the scope frame.
Convenience wrapper that installs a `Self` binding in the type namespace. It explicitly calls `with_self_rib_ns` with `TypeNS`.

Resolves an `impl` block by installing generic and lifetime scopes, resolving the optional trait reference, setting up `Self` bindings for the impl type and constructor namespace, recording trait-impl relationships, and then resolving the impl contents. It explicitly calls `with_generic_param_rib`, `with_self_rib`, `with_lifetime_rib`, `with_optional_trait_ref`, `resolve_doc_links`, `walk_trait_ref`, `visit_ty`, `visit_generics`, `with_current_self_type`, `with_self_rib_ns`, and `resolve_impl_item`.

Resolves an associated item inside an impl, enforcing trait-membership checks when the impl targets a trait and using item-specific generic/lifetime scopes. It explicitly calls `resolve_doc_links`; for associated consts it calls `with_generic_param_rib`, `with_lifetime_rib`, `check_trait_item`, `visit_generics`, `visit_ty`, and `resolve_const_body`; for methods and associated types it uses `with_generic_param_rib`, `check_trait_item`, and `visit::walk_assoc_item`; and for delegations it calls `resolve_delegation`.

Validates that an impl associated item corresponds to an item in the currently referenced trait, records its resolution and visibility, reports missing or duplicate matches, and checks namespace/kind consistency. It explicitly calls `find_similarly_named_assoc_item` to build diagnostics, `report_error` to emit trait-membership errors, and `record_partial_res` to store the resolved trait item.

Resolves a constant expression body under elided-lifetime inference and const-context scoping. It explicitly calls `with_lifetime_rib`, `with_constant_rib`, and then `visit_expr` on the body expression.

Resolves a delegation item by resolving its path, optional qualified self type, and optional synthesized body scope. It explicitly calls `smart_resolve_path`, `visit_ty` for `qself`, `visit_path`, `fresh_binding` to introduce the implicit `self` binding, and `visit_block` for the body.

Resolves function parameters by first resolving parameter patterns under an elided-lifetime rib and then resolving each parameter type. It explicitly calls `with_lifetime_rib`, `resolve_pattern`, and `visit_ty`.
Resolves a local `let` binding by visiting its optional type, initializer, optional `else` block, and finally its pattern. It explicitly calls `visit_expr`, `visit_block`, and `resolve_pattern_top`.

Builds the binding map for a pattern while detecting never-pattern usage and recursively validating nested or-patterns. It explicitly calls `is_base_res_local` to distinguish bindings from path resolutions, `compute_and_check_or_pat_binding_map` for `|` patterns, and `report_error` when bindings appear inside a never pattern.
Checks whether a pattern node’s already-recorded base resolution is a local binding by reading `partial_res_map` and testing for `Res::Local`.

Computes and validates the combined binding map for an or-pattern, ignoring never arms, and reports missing bindings or inconsistent binding modes across alternatives. It explicitly calls `compute_and_check_binding_map` for each subpattern and `report_error` for `VariableNotBoundInPattern` and `VariableBoundWithDifferentMode` diagnostics.

Quickly scans a pattern for or-pattern or never-pattern structure and, if found, triggers full binding-consistency checking. It explicitly calls `compute_and_check_binding_map` when deeper validation is needed.
Resolves a match arm inside a fresh value rib, including its pattern, optional guard, and body. It explicitly calls `with_rib` and `resolve_pattern_top`.
Creates the top-level binding context for a pattern and resolves it. It explicitly calls `resolve_pattern`.

Resolves a pattern in three ordered phases: first walks the pattern with `walk_pat` so literals and substructure are seen before bindings are introduced, then delegates binding/path resolution to `resolve_pattern_inner`, and finally calls `check_consistent_bindings` to validate variant/binding consistency after resolution.

Performs the direct resolution work for each subpattern by walking it recursively, resolving identifier patterns as existing non-bindings via `try_resolve_as_non_binding` or creating new locals via `fresh_binding`, recording partial results, and resolving tuple-struct/path/struct patterns through `smart_resolve_path`; it also manages temporary binding contexts for or-pattern branches.

Creates or reuses a local pattern binding after normalizing the identifier, detecting duplicate bindings across product and or-pattern contexts, reporting duplicate-binding diagnostics through `report_error`, and accessing the current scope via `innermost_rib_bindings` to either reuse an existing or-pattern binding or insert a fresh `Res::Local`.
Returns the mutable binding map for the innermost rib of the requested namespace.

Attempts to interpret an identifier pattern as an already-existing value-space entity instead of a fresh binding by querying `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`, preserving usable constant/unit-ctor resolutions in syntactically ambiguous cases, recording uses when needed, and emitting shadowing/invalid-pattern diagnostics through `report_error` for resolutions that should not be silently rebound.
Convenience wrapper that resolves an AST path by converting it to segments and delegating to `smart_resolve_path_fragment` with finalization and partial-resolution recording enabled.

Core path-resolution routine that selects the namespace from the path source, resolves the path while handling qself/type-relative cases, defers or records partial results, and synthesizes rich use-site diagnostics; within this logic it calls `should_report_errs`, `smart_resolve_report_errors`, `suggest_adding_generic_parameter`, `append_result`, and `resolve_qpath_anywhere`.
Helper that merges a successful `Vec` result into another by appending with `append`, or propagates the first encountered error.
Checks whether `Self` is currently resolvable in the type namespace by calling `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope` on `Self` and rejecting `Res::Err`.
Checks whether `self` is currently resolvable in the value namespace by calling `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope` on a span-tagged `self` identifier and rejecting `Res::Err`.
Reports a resolution error to the underlying resolver only when `should_report_errs` allows diagnostics in the current context.
Returns whether late resolution should emit diagnostics, suppressing them inside rustdoc function bodies and after a global resolution error already exists.

Tries to resolve a qualified path across multiple namespaces by repeatedly calling `resolve_qpath` for the primary, type, and value namespaces, and if unresolved and not type-qualified, falls back to macro lookup before returning the best partial result.

Resolves a possibly type-qualified path, handling `<T>::...` and `<T as Trait>::...` forms specially by calling `smart_resolve_path_fragment` to validate the trait and trait-item prefixes, then producing a partial result that leaves remaining associated segments for type checking or delegates normal path lookup to the lower-level resolver.

Executes a closure in a scope where an optional loop/block label has been registered: it tracks unused labels, checks for prior definitions via `resolve_label`, emits shadowing diagnostics, and introduces the binding with `with_label_rib` before invoking the closure.
Resolves a labeled block by wrapping `visit_block` inside `with_resolved_label` so the block body sees the label binding.

Resolves a block by pushing the appropriate value/type ribs for anonymous modules or normal lexical scope, tracking macro-definition ribs for nested `macro_rules!`, adjusting bare-struct-literal diagnostic state, visiting each statement with `visit_stmt`, and then restoring the prior module and rib stacks.
Resolves an anonymous constant by delegating to `resolve_anon_const_manual`, passing whether the expression is a trivial const argument and resolving the body expression through `resolve_expr`.

Sets up the scope rules for an anonymous constant based on its kind and generic-usage permissions, then resolves its body inside a constant rib and an elided-lifetime rib by calling `with_constant_rib`, `with_lifetime_rib`, and finally the supplied `resolve_expr` closure.
Resolves a struct expression field by resolving the field value with `resolve_expr`, visiting the field identifier with `visit_ident`, and then walking its attributes.

Main expression resolver that first calls `record_candidate_traits_for_expr_if_necessary`, then dispatches by expression kind to resolve paths with `smart_resolve_path`, labels with `resolve_label` and `report_error`, patterns with `resolve_pattern_top`, labeled constructs with `resolve_labeled_block` or `with_resolved_label`, nested blocks with `visit_block`, subexpressions with `resolve_expr`/`visit_expr`, path segments with `visit_path_segment`, and const arguments with `resolve_anon_const_manual`.

Precomputes trait candidates for field and method-call expressions by calling `traits_in_scope` on the accessed name and storing the resulting candidates for later diagnostics and method lookup assistance.
Queries the resolver for traits visible from the current scope and hygiene context that define the given name in the given namespace.
Collects visible lifetime bindings from the current lifetime-rib stack, including earlier synthesized anonymous-lifetime parameters when needed, and stores them for the specified `impl Trait` node.

Resolves a rustdoc link path in a namespace using a per-module cache, delegating cache misses to `resolve_rustdoc_path` and suppressing non-local results that cannot safely be encoded for proc-macro metadata.

Processes doc attributes when configured to do so, resolves each referenced path across namespaces by calling `resolve_and_cache_rustdoc_path`, resolves prefixes for associated-item or diagnostic support, and when needed records trait candidates for doc-link lookup via `traits_in_scope`.
Extracts a function signature’s delegation-relevant shape—header, parameter count, self receiver, and variadic flag—and stores it for the function’s local definition id.

Collects per-item metadata during AST traversal: for items with generics it counts lifetime parameters and stores the count, and for function items it additionally calls `collect_fn_info`; afterward it continues traversal with `walk_item`.
Collects signature metadata for associated functions by calling `collect_fn_info` when the associated item is a function, then continues traversal with `walk_assoc_item`.

Drives the crate-level late name-resolution pass: it first calls `visit::walk_crate` with `ItemInfoCollector` to gather item information, then calls `LateResolutionVisitor::new` to create the main resolver visitor, calls `resolve_doc_links` to resolve crate attribute doc links, calls `visit::walk_crate` again to traverse the expanded crate for late resolution, and finally iterates over collected unused labels and calls `buffer_lint` to emit `UNUSED_LABELS` lints.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/: Constructs an early-bound `ResolvedArg` for a generic parameter and returns it paired with the parameter's local def-id; it calls `to_def_id` to convert the local id for `ResolvedArg::EarlyBound`.

Constructs an innermost late-bound `ResolvedArg` for a generic parameter at the given index and returns it paired with the parameter's local def-id; it calls `to_def_id` to build `ResolvedArg::LateBound`.
Returns the underlying `DefId` for early-bound, late-bound, and free resolved arguments, and `None` for `StaticLifetime` or `Error`; it does not call other methods from the list.
Shifts the De Bruijn depth of a late-bound argument by the given amount and leaves other variants unchanged; for `ResolvedArg::LateBound` it calls `shifted_in` on the depth.
Formats each `Scope` variant in a truncated debug form that omits recursive scope tails; it calls the formatter builder methods `debug_struct`, `field`, and `finish`.

Registers this module's query providers, wiring `resolve_bound_vars`, `is_late_bound_map`, `object_lifetime_default`, and closure-based accessors for stored maps; the accessors call `tcx.resolve_bound_vars(id)` and then `get` on the resulting maps.

Builds the `ResolveBoundVars` result for one HIR owner by creating a `BoundVarContext`, dispatching to the matching visitor entry point, and then copying collected definitions into owner-indexed maps. It calls `hir_owner_node`, then one of `visit_item`, `visit_foreign_item`, `visit_trait_item`, or `visit_impl_item`, and finally uses `entry`, `or_default`, and `insert` to populate the result.

Converts a `ResolvedArg::LateBound` plus its generic parameter into the corresponding `ty::BoundVariableKind`, using the parameter kind to choose region, type, or const binding. It calls `hir`, `local_def_id_to_hir_id`, `expect_local`, and `name` to recover the bound variable's HIR name.
